speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I can see the light. I am in my own bed. I am not on your stair, and I am not asking you to read me anything.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not ask. The light is the one candle. The page is a page. The bundle is still tied, and it is not the page.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then I have what I wanted, which is to know you are not burning the house for a clever ending. Blow it out when the leaf is done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will. She has not drunk. That is as much as the floor is going to get.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I do not know who she is, and I am not learning her through the boards. Good night. One flame, and then the dark. The dark is cheaper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good night. The dark is already in the close. I am not inventing a moon to write by.
